submitMilestoneEvidence(uint256,uint256,.details: Acceptance criteria and budget are copied from the frozen campaign terms and are never supplied by this function.

finalizeCorrectionFailure(uint256,uint25.notice: Ends a failed milestone after the frozen correction allowance is exhausted. Anyone may trigger the terminal refund path.

finalizeFunding(uint256).notice: Permissionless funding transition. Calling after the first finalization is a safe no-op, which makes retries idempotent.

finalizePublication(uint256).notice: Materializes the publication court's canonical outcome before any contribution can enter escrow. This transition is permissionless.

openAppeal(uint256,uint256).notice: Lets an eligible Backer request the next review round. The review engine owns bond accounting, Judge non-overlap and round limits.

openChallenge(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: Challenge review is disabled by the active local policy.

payMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Releases exactly the frozen milestone budget after final PASS and the separate challenge window. No caller-specific authority exists.

resolveChallenge(uint256,uint256).notice: Challenge resolution is disabled by the active local policy.

retryMilestoneReview(uint256,uint256).notice: Opens the next bounded review attempt after an invalid/tied or timed-out review. The review engine owns retry eligibility and Judge pool non-overlap; this contract only moves the milestone pointer.

retryPublication(uint256).notice: Requests the next bounded publication review attempt after the current attempt is eligible for retry. No central party can alter the publication commitment or force the result.

submitMilestoneEvidence(uint256,uint256,.notice: Binds one immutable evidence revision to one review case.

syncFinalRuling(uint256,uint256).notice: Materializes the review engine's canonical final outcome into the milestone state machine. Anyone may call this synchronization.
